title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Scheffler, McIlroy Dominance
items.text: Scottie Scheffler and Rory McIlroy remain the best two golfers globally by a considerable margin, maintaining this status for a significant period.

items.headline: Tiger Woods Returning
items.text: Tiger Woods is preparing for a return to world-ranking competitive golf after more than two years away since his last competition.

items.headline: Koepka on Scheffler’s 2024
items.text: Brooks Koepka commented on Scottie Scheffler's significant success on the PGA Tour since his first victory in February 2022.
